balance_id: txnbuild.TransactionFromXDR sets sourceAccount.AccountID = SourceAccount().Address(), which for a KEY_TYPE_MUXED_ED25519 source is the 69 char M address; Transaction.ClaimableBalanceID then calls xdr.MustMuxedAddress(M) -> MuxedAccount.SetAddress, where len 69 hits case 69. With case 68 the M address falls to default ('invalid address length'), MustMuxedAddress panics. Every balance_id vector in the corpus has an unmuxed G source, so only the case 56 arm runs. Verified by calling v0.9.0 directly on that input. Killing input: op balance_id, TransactionEnvelope, TransactionEnvelope (ENVELOPE_TYPE_TX) base64 AAAAAgAAAQAAAAAAAAAAARERERERERERERERERERERERERERERERERERERERERERAAAAZAAAAAEAAAABAAAAAAAAAAAAAAABAAAAAAAAAA4AAAAAAAAAAACYloAAAAABAAAAAAAAAAAiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIiIgAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA== , op_index 0, any network_passphrase. One CreateClaimableBalance (native, 1 XLM, one unconditional claimant 0x22*32) whose tx source is the muxed account KEY_TYPE_MUXED_ED25519 {id 1, ed25519 0x11*32} = MAIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCAAAAAAAAAAAAE76M (69 chars). Core derives the id from the underlying account, so the expected answer equals that of the same tx with the plain source GAIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCEIRCF6M; to be a corpus check it must be applied on a chain so anchors.rs emits it; unmodified: balance_id 000000001148bdf459d6efd2339e3de4ed0fabf5912ce9fa8c87786f60b7dd804c7b21be (same as for the plain G source); faulty: MustMuxedAddress panics with 'invalid address length': the testee answers error class panic.
